messages.subject: Project Sable - initial review of contract pack
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

First pass through the Calder Whitmore pack. Headlines:

1. Title GM921044 is absolute freehold, single P restriction re a Clydesford Bank charge - that needs discharging on completion (undertaking).
2. Four leases; WAULT ~7.4 yrs. Northbridge (floors 2-3, 28.9% of income) has a tenant break at Sep 2026 - worth flagging to the client.
3. Deposit drafted as held 'as agent' - we'll push back to stakeholder.
4. Completion period drafted at 20 working days; they may want to shorten.
5. TOGC/option to tax looks fine subject to client registering and opting.

Elena is drafting the report on title. Anything you'd add before we send the mark-up?

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.subject: RE: Project Sable - initial review of contract pack
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Good summary. Agreed on all five. On the deposit, hold the line on stakeholder but it isn't a deal-breaker; if they insist on agent, we report the point and let the client take a view. Make sure we get a retention or indemnity for any live service charge disputes.

Let's get the report to Isla by mid-October so the board can approve before exchange.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
